input: Start a monthly family letter for distant relatives

gold.taskTitle: Start a Monthly Family Letter for Distant Relatives
gold.taskDescription: Create and launch a recurring monthly letter to keep distant relatives informed and connected with family updates.

questions.title: Will this be sent digitally, by post, or both?
questions.description: Clarify the delivery format so we can plan the right tools and process.

questions.title: Who will write the letter each month?
questions.description: Determine whether one person is responsible or if it rotates among family members.

questions.title: How many relatives are on the recipient list?
questions.description: Understand the audience size to plan distribution logistics appropriately.

questions.title: What tone do you want — formal, casual, or storytelling?
questions.description: Establish the voice and style that fits the family and its recipients.

questions.title: What kinds of updates should the letter regularly include?
questions.description: Identify the recurring content categories such as milestones, photos, family news, or schedules.

questions.title: Which day of the month should the letter go out?
questions.description: Pin down a consistent send date to build a reliable routine.

questions.title: Do you want a consistent template or a fresh layout each time?
questions.description: Decide whether to design a reusable structure or keep the format flexible month to month.
